2609.02364.title: Towards a Foundational Ontology for Identifying and Resolving Contradictions in Dialogue-based Human-Robot Interactions
2609.02364.paper_summary: Existing Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) literature has focused on identifying and structuring errors, failures, conflicts, and knowledge issues (called in this work as contradictions) in domain-specific dialogue-based interactions. However, there is still lack of a formal computational framework to represent and define these contradictions, interoperable and usable across HRI and human-agent interaction (HAI) domains. Thus, this research project aims to capture, represent, and evaluate the notion of (1) dialogue-based collaborative interaction and (2) related contradictions in a foundational ontology. METHONTOLOGY, a systematic approach to build domain-independent ontologies was applied. In the conceptualisation stage of the presented ontology, concepts and models from Activity Theory were used. Preliminary results presented in this short article are: (i) Natural language definitions of dialogues and related contradictions in HRI, (ii) Set Theoretic definitions of dialogues and contradictions, and (iii) First Order Logic (FoL) formulation of the contradiction concepts and three novel principles guiding dialogue-based interactions between humans and robots. In summary, we report on ongoing work to develop a foundational ontology based on Activity Theory called Activity Theory-based foundational ontology (ATFOt) to capture and represent the notion of contradictions in HRI.
2609.02364.paper_summary_zh: 現有的人機互動（HRI）文獻專注於識別和結構化錯誤、失敗、衝突和知識問題（在本研究中稱為矛盾）於特定領域的對話式互動中。<lb/>然而，目前仍缺乏一個正式的計算框架來表示和定義這些矛盾，並能夠在HRI和人機代理互動（HAI）領域之間互操作和使用。<lb/>因此，本研究項目旨在捕捉、表示和評估（1）基於對話的協作互動和（2）相關矛盾的概念，並建立一個基礎本體。<lb/>METHONTOLOGY，一種構建領域獨立本體的系統方法被應用。在所呈現本體的概念化階段，使用了活動理論中的概念和模型。<lb/>本文中呈現的初步結果包括：（i）HRI中對話及相關矛盾的自然語言定義，（ii）對話和矛盾的集合論定義，以及（iii）矛盾概念的第一階邏輯（FoL）表述和三個指導人類與機器人之間基於對話的互動的新原則。<lb/>總之，我們報告了基於活動理論的基礎本體（ATFOt）正在開發中的工作，以捕捉和表示HRI中矛盾的概念。
